_comment: Single source of truth for café details. Leave a value null when it is not confirmed; the site then hides it or shows 'please call'. Never fill in guesses.

hours._comment: Fill ONLY with hours confirmed by the café. weekly: [{days:[0..6 Mon-Sun], opens:'HH:MM', closes:'HH:MM'}]; seasons: [{name:{en,el}, from:'MM-DD', to:'MM-DD', weekly:[...]}]; special: [{date:'YYYY-MM-DD', closed:true, note:{en,el}}] or with opens/closes; notice: {en, el, until:'YYYY-MM-DD'} for temporary closures.

menuSource.note: Transcribed from the menu images on yiasemi.gr (headed 'MENU · Thiseio · Yiasemi Cottage'). Client must confirm it applies to the Plaka café.
